selected.title: Revolut faces Bank of England scrutiny over product approval process, reports say
selected.why: Bank of England scrutiny of a major fintech's product approvals is a key regulatory development.

reason: Bank of England scrutiny of Revolut's product approval process raises a genuine debate about regulatory philosophy: whether intensive pre-approval oversight or post-market enforcement better serves consumers and innovation.
angle: Regulators should enforce compliance after launch rather than bottleneck innovation through exhaustive pre-approval processes
